Meet the Founder

Hi, I'm Tatiana.

I love creating beautiful spaces — working with flowers, watching an idea become real.

My love for event design began with creating birthday celebrations for my own children. Every party was thoughtfully planned, filled with handmade details, flowers, and little moments of joy. Over time, I realized I wasn't simply decorating events — I was creating memories.

I moved to Charlotte and couldn't find what I was looking for. So I built it.

BloomScape — Charlotte's luxury event designer — grew out of that, not out of a business plan. My inspiration comes from European design, fashion, and nature — every celebration should feel personal, built around the people it's for.

It's always been about more than décor. It's about designing memories.

FAQ

Common questions.

How far in advance should I book?+
We recommend booking 4–12 weeks in advance to ensure availability and allow plenty of time for planning and custom design. If your event is sooner, feel free to reach out — we'll always do our best to accommodate you.
Do you travel?+
Yes! BloomScape proudly serves Charlotte, NC, and surrounding areas, including Lake Norman, Fort Mill, Waxhaw, and nearby communities. We also accept destination events upon request.
Can you work at private homes?+
Absolutely. We design celebrations at private homes, backyards, event venues, restaurants, and other locations. We'll work with your space to create a beautiful and seamless experience.
Do you provide flowers?+
Yes. We offer both fresh and premium artificial floral designs, depending on your vision, budget, and event needs. We'll recommend the best option during the design process.
Can I rent individual décor items?+
At this time, we focus on full-service event styling rather than individual décor rentals. This allows us to create cohesive, beautifully designed celebrations from start to finish.
What happens if it rains?+
For outdoor events, we always recommend having a backup plan. We'll work with you and your venue to discuss alternative options and make any necessary adjustments if weather becomes a concern.
Do you require a deposit?+
Yes. A signed agreement and a non-refundable retainer are required to reserve your event date.
